Section: carbon
Valid as of: 2026-10-05
Next review: 2027-01-06T03:00:00Z
Forma temporal: three_points
Referências jurídicas disponíveis: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 (norm); 2025 CBAM simplification amendment (norm); European Commission (institution)
Provenance permitida para esta seção (use estes sourceId literalmente em evidenceRefs e whatToWatch.sourceId):
source-carbon-ec | https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/carbon-border-adjustment-mechanism_en | publica: preço do CBAM, marcos regulatórios, orientações e atos de execução do CBAM | dado: verified, direct
Eventos disponíveis (opcional em claims[].eventRefs): evt-cbam-definitive-start | 2026-01-01 | Start of the definitive CBAM regime; evt-cbam-first-annual-declaration | 2027-09-30 | Deadline of the first annual CBAM declaration
Context:
Carbon pricing/CBAM (Regulation (EU) 2023/956, as amended by the 2025 CBAM simplification amendment). Q3 2026 price: 82.32 €/tCO2e; Q2 2026: 75.28 €/tCO2e; the Q3 2026 price is above the Q2 2026 price. Six sectors. De minimis: 50 t/year annual aggregate per importer for covered goods. Definitive period in force since 2026-01-01. First annual CBAM declaration (covering 2026 imports) due by 2027-09-30; this is a declaration deadline, not the start of the definitive regime. In the definitive regime the authorized EU importer is legally responsible for declaring embedded emissions; Brazilian exporters may face indirect requests for verifiable installation-level data. Effects on costs/competitiveness are possibilities. Do not use national per-capita emissions. Source: source-carbon-ec.

Eventos disponíveis (opcional em claims[].eventRefs): nenhum
Context:
Digital assets. Stablecoin market capitalization: US$ 283.8 bilhões; Tether: US$ 184.1 bilhões. This is market capitalization, not international payment volume. RWA sample: Invesco USTB: US$ 597.7 milhões TVL; Ethena USDtb: US$ 470.3 milhões TVL; Re: US$ 405.5 milhões TVL; partial sample of individual protocols, not a sector total. Prices include BTC, ETH, SOL and BNB snapshots. Interpretation may discuss digital dollar rails and local-currency narratives, but cannot claim causation. Temporal shape: single-day snapshot; no time series is available in this dataset, so variation over time cannot be established yet. Suggested What to Watch: the next DefiLlama update of stablecoin market capitalization, which will allow the first temporal comparison. Sources: source-defillama-stablecoins, source-defillama-rwa, source-defillama-coins.

source-open-meteo-brasilia | https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=-15.8&longitude=-47.9&start_date=2025-10-06&end_date=2026-10-05&daily=temperature_2m_mean,precipitation_sum&timezone=auto | publica: temperatura média diária e precipitação diária em Brasília | dado: verified, derived
Eventos disponíveis (opcional em claims[].eventRefs): nenhum
Context:
Climate vector for Brasília. Rolling 12-month window 2025-10-06 to 2026-10-05; mean temperature 22.4°C (above the 21.4°C reference); precipitation 1361 mm (below the 1550 mm reference). The reference benchmarks (21.4°C and 1550 mm) are dashboard references, not an official climatology. A single city cannot establish impacts on producing regions, commodities or energy. Any transmission to commodities, hydrology, energy or FX must be a hypothesis and should be monitored against producing regions and relevant river basins. Source: source-open-meteo-brasilia.
